body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently corroborate PR942's signed-dual supporting lemma throughout **0 < z <= 1/500** with an elementary integral proof and exact rational certificate. All **1,163 bin vectors** and **42 strict rank obligations** pass; the conservative normalized margin is at least **24274/28675 > 4/5**. The main checker imports neither retained moment engine and evaluates no cube roots or transcendental functions. A separate exact-fill/fixed-point implementation checks the entire table and gives margins above 3.

**Status: mathematical audit / independent verification; no new kappa.** The selected endpoint lies inside the proved interval. Root/outer/controller/physical admission are not replayed, and all inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain.

### Concurrent work

**PR995 (@woklerx), head 93a8127b990f9755d0c80e729b40c969d6c611e4, published the wider uniform-support result first**, covering 0 < b <= 1/3 by monotonicity and integer cube-root certificates. Its actual proof was inspected. This package adds a meaningfully different elementary rational proof near the selected endpoint and another fixed-point checking method; no range superiority or priority is claimed. PR992's sharp integrality penalties are separate. Neither package's code is consumed.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/t37-support-audit-seed66/verify.py
```

Expected: PASS_T37_UNIFORM_SUPPORT_AUDIT bins=1163 ranks=42 z=(0,1/500] minimum_margin=24274/28675 no_new_kappa.

Normal/optimized CPython 3.9.6 macOS arm64 replay, separate checker, seven mathematical mutations, four exact boundary controls, optimized standalone relocation, complete byte-identical certificate regeneration, 12 actual on-disk corruptions, two independent arithmetic mutations, all four source SHA256/Git-blob bindings, selected-record integrity, five existing selected-result tests and whitespace checks pass. Reversed credit and out-of-range z=2 have explicit counterexamples; neither falsifies the accepted lemma. Real-count equality and integer divisibility by 37 are distinguished. No full suite, native cold replay, hosted CI, Lean or independent human review is claimed.

Exact base: **407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515**. Refreshed main: **8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20**; consumed inputs are unchanged. OS seed **66**, adversarial audit track. Only research/t37-support-audit-seed66/ is added. Local claim is updated once with result/link; no coordination issue exists. Published tree equals the verified local tree.

Credits: Jonathan Capalbo PR942; Chafik Boukhalfa PR795/890; Jeremy Kothe's U8; Hao Yan's T16; unchanged PR589/555 and retained source notices. Concurrent PR962, PR995 and PR992 are credited with their precise scopes. Prepared by **Eva Ayala / ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI mathematics/checking/review. Apache-2.0. No selected frontier or upstream source changes, and no merge is requested.
